clusters.question: 1 component name(s) are exported from more than one file, between src/components/kit and src/components/ui. Which file is the public one for each name?

options.label: Directory src/components/ui is the public layer
options.consequence: 1 component name(s): the file in src/components/ui is the public one and the 1 other file(s) are listed as shadowed; no component leaves the output

options.label: Directory src/components/kit is the public layer
options.consequence: 1 component name(s): the file in src/components/kit is the public one and the 1 other file(s) are listed as shadowed; no component leaves the output

options.label: Review individually
options.consequence: a sheet lists the 1 component name(s) with their files; you choose per name
